versions.changelog:
- Improved and clarified documentation for the Amazon Products By Category skill, making the required inputs, endpoint details, and output rules more concise and explicit.
- Updated skill description and usage instructions to emphasize the single supported endpoint (`GET /api/amazon/get-category-products/v1`) and required `categoryId` parameter.
- Enhanced tables and enum value listings for all parameters to ensure parameter expectations are easy to reference.
- Aligned output guidelines to prioritize operation ID, used path, and core Amazon product fields (title, price, rating) in responses.
- No changes to API logic or endpoint behavior—only documentation and guidance updates.

- Updated generated files to reflect latest API operation details.
- No changes to the skill interface or user instructions.
- Minor behind-the-scenes improvements for operation documentation and command usage.
